scope: Offline documentation lifecycle correction found while recording the authorized production release; no application runtime or deployment configuration changed.
finding: The validator rejected proposed/rejected decisions with deployed/verified evidence even when target, revision, timestamp and retained evidence were supplied. This contradicted the explicit separation of ADR decision status and delivery observations and pressured a false acceptance transition.
correction: Removed only the decision-status coupling. Evidence, target/revision/time, source-review, publication and lifecycle-link checks remain. Canonical lifecycle guidance explains that an observation neither approves a decision nor authorizes future deployment.

semantic_review.result: Compared the complete decision validation and generation paths with the accepted knowledge ADR and canonical lifecycle guidance. Confirmed no automatic status mutation and retained independent evidence requirements.

new_coverage: Proposed/rejected deployment and verification records keep their status through validation and index generation
Unaccepted decisions still cannot claim deployment without release evidence and target/revision/time

limitations: Structural validation does not independently authenticate deployment evidence. No new production load, generation or exhaustive module audit is implied.
